note: WAEC Geography round 3 (Round 21 top-up): equator and Greenwich, 15-degrees-per-hour local time, earth's layers, igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks, frost weathering, river courses and meanders, waterfalls and gorges, deltas, dendritic and radial drainage, wave erosion, cliffs, tombolos, tides, warm and cold currents (Benguela), weather instruments (barometer, anemometer), daily temperature range, equatorial climate, Sudan savanna, Sahel, soil horizons, texture, pH and laterite, census, density, population pyramids, migration, nucleated and linear settlement, urbanisation, Enugu coal, Jos tin, Niger Delta oil, Itakpe iron ore, industrial location, Kainji Dam, floods, drought, desertification, afforestation and gully-erosion control. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO Geography and the JAMB pool.
